{
  "project_id": "P-MEX-SustainableValueChains",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Insufficient demand from SMEs and mid‑caps for sustainable finance could lead to under‑utilization of loan facilities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement aggressive outreach, anchor‑company engagement, and incentive schemes to stimulate applications and maintain pipeline.",
      "evidence": "Demand analysis estimated 1,200‑2,500 SMEs interested; market for sustainable finance remains nascent and concentrated among large corporations (Section 7‑8)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Participating financial intermediaries lack technical capacity to appraise, monitor and verify green and sustainability‑linked loans.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deliver targeted TA, training, templates and digital tools to PFIs; certify readiness before loan rollout.",
      "evidence": "Supply side: Mexican financial institutions limited in capacity to design, originate, appraise and monitor green loans; <15% offer dedicated green products (Section 15)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "High Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) costs may deter SMEs from participating or cause inaccurate reporting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Subsidize MRV expenses through grant funding and provide technical assistance to reduce cost burden.",
      "evidence": "Key constraints go beyond tenor to include high MRV costs and limited capacity to structure, appraise and monitor investments (Section 13)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Risk of green‑washing if sustainability plans and KPIs are not properly validated.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Require ex‑ante validation and ex‑post verification by an independent entity for all Sustainability Plans.",
      "evidence": "Targets and results in the SP will be subject to ex‑ante validation and ex‑post verification by a qualified, independent validation entity (Section 1a)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Credit risk concentration on mid‑cap borrowers could generate losses for NAFIN if defaults occur.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply exposure limits, diversify portfolio across firms and sectors, and enforce minimum co‑financing requirements.",
      "evidence": "Maximum sub‑loan size US$15 million for mid‑caps; single borrower exposure limits US$20 million (Section 29)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Foreign‑exchange risk for loans denominated in USD may affect repayment ability of MXN‑earning firms.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Limit USD loans to firms with natural hedges and manage FX exposure via currency swaps on NAFIN’s balance sheet.",
      "evidence": "Financing will mostly be in local currency; USD lending available for firms with clear natural hedge; NAFIN will manage FX risk using swap market (Section 31)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Delays in developing and launching the novel SLL and GL products could postpone project benefits.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Adopt a phased pilot approach with clear milestones and monitor progress against the implementation schedule.",
      "evidence": "First systematic application of SLL in Mexican financial system; focus on developing detailed operational framework (Section 1a)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Private capital mobilization target of US$89 million may not be achieved, reducing leverage effect.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Create attractive co‑financing terms, conduct investor outreach, and consider guarantee instruments to de‑risk private participation.",
      "evidence": "Project will help mobilize an estimated US$89 million in private capital; minimum 20% BE co‑financing and 30% PFI co‑financing required (Section 28)."
